one_month_reasoning: No scheduled company or policy catalyst falls inside Oct 1-30. Q3 2026 results: no 8-K or date announcement on EDGAR, every Q3 since 2021 was reported Nov 2-7 and MarketBeat lists Nov 5 as estimated, so I now put only ~10% on an in-window print (round 1: ~25%). China's export-control suspension, which I had expiring Nov 10, was extended at the Sep 24-25 Trump-Xi visit to Jan 10 2027, so that cliff is also outside the window. That leaves headline risk (China/Shenghe stories, DoW news) and a stock that fell ~21% in a month with ~23% of float short, which can squeeze or keep liquidating. With no edge I use a near-symmetric lognormal with median ~$47.0 (a hair below spot for continued sector de-rating) and monthly sigma ~20% (74%/3.5, trimmed slightly because no earnings are in the window).

fair_value.method: Blend of NTM EV/EBITDA at Sep-2027 ($400M x 19x = $7.6B EV + ~$1.32B net cash/claims over ~239.3M FD shares = ~$37.3, weight 0.4), a 2030 DCF-lite ($750M x 14x discounted 3 yrs at 11%, less remaining 10X capex = ~$35.1, weight 0.3) and an SOTP of floor-protected Materials, Independence, the 10X guarantee and an HREE/strategic option (~$36.9, weight 0.3) gives ~$36.5. The sell-side cross-check is dropped.

bear.story: Theme deflates further: a durable US-China deal by Jan 10 2027 removes the scarcity premium; Independence/GM commercial shipments slip past Q4-26 or yields disappoint; 10X cost/schedule slips and cash (down $380M in H1-26 to $1.45B, H1 FCF -$303M) forces an equity or convert raise in 2027; NdPr stays below the $110 floor so earnings are visibly PPA-driven (62% of Q2 adj. EBITDA); bill-and-hold (47-48% of revenue) and receivables ($14.6M->$40.4M) draw scrutiny; stock re-rates to ~14-15x a missed ~$350M NTM EBITDA.

base.story: Ramp roughly on plan but a little behind consensus: NTM EBITDA ~$400-450M at Sep-2027, commercial magnet shipments under way, 10X on track for 2028; the premium compresses as the story becomes execution, CEO selling continues, and the stock trades a little below today's level in a wide range.

bull.story: Talks stall into the Jan 10 2027 cliff and China re-imposes or widens export controls; ex-China NdPr/HREE premiums widen, new DoW/allied offtakes, Independence and 10X ahead of plan; scarcity premium returns toward the $100 52-week high, helped by a short squeeze (23% of float short).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$28 (just under the $30.03 DoW preferred/warrant price and ~40% below spot) the ~239M-share equity would be worth ~$6.7B, close to the supervisor-verified contracted value of the DoW floor, the 10X guarantee and net cash (~$22-28/share) with nothing for Independence magnets or heavy rare earths. A trade there would most likely mean a failed GM qualification, a 10X funding gap or dilutive raise, a change in DoW support or an accounting problem, not ordinary 74%-vol noise. I keep $28 rather than the supervisor's $30 because at 74% vol a move to $30 is a ~1-sigma event that a merely bad January policy outcome could cause.

10X cost and schedule (commissioning 2028, >$1.25B capex) and whether 2027 cash burn forces new equity or converts
China export-control path into the Jan 10 2027 cliff and its effect on NdPr prices and the scarcity premium
Whether the ~4x step-up in EBITDA embedded in 2027-28 consensus ($377.7M/$540M vs ~$114M run rate) materializes
Quality of revenue: bill-and-hold $51.3M (47%) in Q2 and receivables $14.6M->$40.4M; disclosed GAAP practice, a watch item rather than evidence of misstatement
Durability of DoW support (price floor, offtake, preferred) across political cycles
Short interest ~23% of float can drive violent squeezes in either direction
reasoning: Skeptic lane, round 2. The supervisor confirmed my bear facts (bill-and-hold 47%, PPA 62% of adj. EBITDA, receivables tripling, SI 23%) and found CEO sales were larger (~$77.9M), but fixed three errors I accept: convert dilution is 34.4M shares at $21.74 with a capped call to $31.06 (I re-read the 10-Q note and confirmed both), the China suspension now runs to Jan 10 2027 (CNBC, Rinnovabili, BISI), and my $280M NTM EBITDA ignored that at the horizon the market prices 2028 numbers (MarketScreener 2027 $377.7M, 2028 $540M, which I re-fetched). I agree bill-and-hold and PPA income are quality flags, not misstatement evidence, and stopped leaning on GF Value/Simply Wall St outputs. Revised fundamentals: NTM EBITDA $400M (20% haircut to time-weighted consensus) x 19x, a 2030 DCF-lite and an SOTP all land at $35-37 per FD share; I dropped the $57 sell-side cross-check (30% weight in round 1), so the blended fair value falls from $40 to ~$36.5 even though the pure fundamental methods rose from $30-36 to $35-37. I disagree with the supervisor's $44: its NTM base ($450M) haircut is smaller than MP's ramp record warrants, and it assumes ~$0.9B burn yet still adds ~$1.0B of claims; I differ mainly on the haircut, not the facts. Distribution: the stock prices a strategic premium a fundamental model will not capture and the Jan 10 cliff sits inside the horizon, so I only pull the median ~25% of the way toward fair value: lognormal median ~$44.5, sigma ~0.65 (below 74% given floor/net cash), with a thicker left-middle floor (~$22-28 contracted value) and a fat right tail for re-escalation. Versus round 1 the ladder is ~0-1 pt higher in the middle and ~1 pt fatter in the right tail. Research this round: 3 web lookups plus a direct read of the 10-Q; no option data consulted; Seeking Alpha remains blocked.
